title: Sharjah Booksellers Conference 2026
summary: The only publishing group from Türkiye at the fifth edition.
body:
The fifth Sharjah Booksellers Conference brought booksellers, distributors, publishers and e-commerce platforms from 98 countries together. Epsilon Publishing Group attended as the only publishing group from Türkiye.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/sharjah-booksellers-conference-2026/)
seo_description: Epsilon Publishing Group attended the fifth Sharjah Booksellers Conference, 19–20 September 2026, the only publishing group from Türkiye.
